metadata.title: Cooky: what do I cook today?
metadata.description: Your recipe box, your kitchen and the weather, together. Cooky helps you decide what to cook, plan the week, shop once and cook with friends.

home.headline: What do I cook today?
home.tagline: Plan, cook, and shop without the guesswork.
home.featuresHeading: Everything for the kitchen, in one place

dishes.title: My dishes

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms are the agreement between you and Cooky when you use the app. We've kept them short and in plain words.

service.title: What Cooky is
service.body: Cooky is a home-cooking companion: a recipe box, tools to decide what to cook, plan meals, shop and time your cooking, and a way to share recipes and chat with friends. Some features are free; others are part of the paid Plus and Pro plans described on the Pricing page.

account.title: Your account
account.body:
You need to be at least 16 to create an account. Keep your password private and tell us if you think someone else is using your account. You're responsible for what happens under your account.

You can delete your account at any time from Settings → Your data.

content.title: Your recipes and content
content.body:
Recipes, photos, notes, reviews and messages you add stay yours. You give Cooky permission to store them and to show them to you and to the people you choose to share them with, only to run the service.

Only add content you have the right to share. Recipes imported from a website keep a link to their source.

sharing.title: Sharing and friends
sharing.body: Dishes are private until you choose to share them with all your friends or with groups you pick. Friends can read a shared dish and copy it to their own recipe box. You can stop sharing, unfriend or block someone at any time.

conduct.title: Using Cooky fairly
conduct.body: Don't use Cooky to spam, harass or deceive anyone, to share illegal or hateful content, or to break, overload or get around the service and its limits. We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these rules. You can report a person, dish, review or message from the app.

plans.title: Paid plans and tries
plans.body:
Paid plans renew automatically each month or year until you cancel. Prices are shown before you pay and include tax where it applies. Some features use tries (for example the Assistant); the number of tries per period depends on your plan and is shown in the app.

A free trial is offered once per account. Payments are handled by Stripe. Our Refund policy explains cancellations and refunds.

availability.title: Availability and changes
availability.body: We work to keep Cooky available and your data safe, but we can't promise the service will never be interrupted. We may change or remove features; if a change takes away something you pay for, we'll tell you in advance.

liability.title: Responsibility
liability.body:
Cooky's suggestions (including AI suggestions, nutrition values and weather) are there to help, not to replace your own judgement. Check ingredients for allergies and food safety yourself.

We're not liable for indirect losses. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under the law of the country you live in.

ending.title: Ending the agreement
ending.body: You can stop using Cooky and delete your account whenever you want. We may suspend or close an account that seriously or repeatedly breaks these terms, and we'll tell you why unless the law prevents it.

law.title: Applicable law
law.body: These terms are governed by the law of the country where Cooky's operator is established, as shown in the Imprint, without taking away the protection of the law of the country where you live.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: If we change these terms in a way that matters, we'll tell you in the app or by email before the new version applies. The version you accepted is recorded with your account.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This explains what Cooky collects, why, who helps us run it, and the choices you have. We collect as little as we can and we never sell your data.

who.title: Who is responsible
who.body: The operator named in the Imprint is responsible for your personal data in Cooky.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body:
Account: your name, email address, password (stored only as a secure hash) or your Google/Apple sign-in, and the version of these documents you accepted.

What you add: recipes, photos, notes, ratings and reviews, your kitchen, plans, events, shopping lists, Assistant conversations, friends, groups, messages and reports.

Settings: language, appearance, units, the city you set (or rough device coordinates, rounded to about 1 km, if you choose "use my location"), dietary preferences and notification choices.

Technical: signed-in devices (browser and system), and an IP address stored only as a keyed hash for security. Error reports leave out personal content.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To run Cooky for you: show and sync your recipes, rank dishes, plan and shop, deliver messages and notifications, and process payments. To keep accounts safe (sign-in protection, abuse prevention) and to fix problems. We don't use your data for advertising and we don't build advertising profiles.

legalBasis.title: Legal bases
legalBasis.body: Providing the service you signed up for (contract). Keeping Cooky secure and preventing abuse (legitimate interests). Notifications and device location, only if you turn them on (consent, which you can withdraw in Settings). Keeping billing records (legal obligation).

processors.title: Who helps us run Cooky
processors.body: These providers process data for us, only on our instructions and under data processing agreements:

transfers.title: Transfers outside your country
transfers.body: Some providers are based in or use servers in the United States. Where data leaves the European Economic Area, we rely on the safeguards the law requires, such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.body:
Your account data is kept while you have an account. Deleted dishes and collections can be restored for a day, then are removed. Deleted message text is wiped after a day. Assistant conversations you haven't used for 90 days are removed. Data exports can be downloaded for 24 hours, then the file is deleted.

When you delete your account, everything is removed 7 days later (you can cancel by logging in during that time), including your photos and your billing customer. Payment providers keep the invoices the law requires.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can see, correct, download and delete your data. Settings → Your data lets you download a full copy and delete your account; Settings also lets you change your profile, notification choices and who can see your dishes. You can also object to processing or ask us to restrict it, and complain to your data protection authority.

security.title: Security
security.body: Data is encrypted in transit, photos are stored privately and shown only through short-lived links, passwords are hashed and checked against known breaches, and you can add two-step verification or passkeys. Other people never see your email address.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Cooky uses only the cookies it needs: to keep you signed in, remember your language and keep sign-in safe. There are no advertising or tracking cookies, so there's no cookie banner. Your device may also store your theme, text size, running timers and, if you allow it, your shopping list for offline use; signing out clears the offline copy.

children.title: Children
children.body: Cooky isn't meant for children under 16, and we don't knowingly collect their data.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we change this policy in a way that matters, we'll tell you before it applies. The version you accepted is recorded with your account.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.intro: How cancelling, trials and refunds work for Cooky's paid plans.

summary.title: In short
summary.body: You can cancel any time. Your plan stays until the end of the period you paid for, and nothing you added is deleted when you go back to Free.

cancel.title: Cancelling
cancel.body: Cancel from Settings → Plan & billing. You keep your plan until the end of the current month or year, and it won't renew. Free trials can be cancelled before they end without being charged.

withdrawal.title: Your 14-day right of withdrawal
withdrawal.body: If you live in the EU or the UK, you can withdraw from a new subscription within 14 days of the first payment. Because the paid features start right away when you subscribe, we may keep an amount for the days you already used, as the law allows.

request.title: Asking for a refund
request.body: Tell us within 14 days of a payment and we'll refund it if the law requires it, or if something went wrong on our side (for example, you were charged twice). Refunds go back to the payment method you used.

failed.title: Failed payments
failed.body: If a renewal payment fails, you keep your plan for 7 days while you update your card. After that, your account moves to Free.

downgrade.title: Moving to a smaller plan
downgrade.body: Nothing is deleted. If you have more than the new plan allows (for example, more dishes), the extra stays viewable and cookable, but you can't add more until you're back under the limit or upgrade.

imprint.title: Imprint
imprint.intro: Who runs Cooky and how to contact us.
imprint.operatorPending: The operator's details are published here before Cooky opens to the public.

disputes.title: Consumer disputes
disputes.body: The European Commission provides an online dispute resolution platform at https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr. We prefer to solve problems directly: please contact us first.

pricing.intro: Cooking, planning and shopping are free for everyone. Paid plans add more AI help, more room and ways to cook together.

trial.q: How does the free trial work?
trial.a: Your first paid plan starts with {days} free days. Cancel before the trial ends and you pay nothing. Each account gets one trial.

cancel.a: Yes, from Settings → Plan & billing. You keep your plan until the end of the period you paid for, then move to Free.

downgrade.q: What happens to my dishes if I move to Free?
downgrade.a: Nothing is deleted. If you have more than Free allows, you can still view and cook everything. You just can't add more until you're under the limit or upgrade.

tries.a: AI and import features use tries: one question, one dictation, one import or one spin. If something fails on our side, the try is given back. Free tries reset on the 1st of each month, paid plans on your billing day, and spins every day.

switch.q: Can I switch between Plus and Pro?
switch.a: Yes, any time, from Settings → Plan & billing. Stripe adjusts the price for the rest of your billing period.

payment.a: Payments go through Stripe, a secure payment provider. Cooky never sees your card number. You can update your card or download invoices any time.

suspend.body: They're signed out everywhere, can't log in, and disappear from search. You can lift it any time.

unsuspend.title: Lift {name}'s suspension?
unsuspend.body: They'll be able to log in again.

signOut.title: Sign {name} out everywhere?
signOut.body: Every device they're logged in on will need to log in again.

makeAdmin.title: Make {name} an admin?
makeAdmin.body: They'll see this panel and can do everything you can, including managing other admins.

revokeAdmin.title: Remove {name}'s admin role?
revokeAdmin.body: They'll lose access to this panel.

delete.title: Delete {name}'s account?
delete.body: This can't be undone. Their recipes, photos, chats and billing customer are removed right away, without a grace period.

catalog.heading: Catalog
catalog.description: {count, plural, one {# Discover dish} other {# Discover dishes}}. Missing translations are flagged.
catalog.none: The catalog is empty. Add the first dish.
catalog.saves: {count, plural, =0 {not saved yet} one {saved by # person} other {saved by # people}}
catalog.formHint: English is required. French and Arabic are shown when filled in; otherwise people see the English text.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.slugHint: Lowercase words joined by dashes, e.g. chicken-tagine. Must be unique.
catalog.countryHint: Two-letter code, e.g. MA for Morocco.
catalog.slugTaken: Another dish already uses this slug. Pick a different one.
catalog.checkFields: Some fields need fixing: every English text, a slug and a two-letter country are required.
catalog.deleteBody: It disappears from Discover. People who saved it keep their copy.

content.heading: Content
content.description: Recent reviews and dishes people share with friends.
content.deleteReviewBody: {name}'s review and rating are removed for good.
content.makePrivateBody: Friends stop seeing it. The owner keeps the dish.
content.deleteDishBody: This removes the dish from {name}'s recipe box for good.

reports.heading: Reports
reports.description: What people reported. The person reported never sees who reported them.
reports.noneOpen: No open reports. All caught up.
reports.handleBody: Choose an outcome. Everything you do here is recorded in the audit log.

feedback.heading: Feedback
feedback.deleteBody: The message is removed for good.

audit.heading: Audit log
audit.description: Every admin action and sensitive account action, newest first.
audit.searchPlaceholder: Action starts with, e.g. admin. or auth.

og.headline: What do I cook today?
og.line: Your recipes, your kitchen and the weather: decide, plan, shop and cook with friends.
